topic: Student-led anti-Noboa protest wave (paro) over government cuts to education and health, security and economic crisis
scale: Thousands in Quito on Oct 10 (mainly high school and college students); coordinated marches in 19 of Ecuador's 24 provinces on Oct 8
quote1: For its part, the October 10 demonstration – which consisted mainly of high school and college students – set out from the Central University and marched through Quito
quote2: The October 8 march traces its origins to an assembly of popular organizations gathered in Quito on September 26, where delegations representing teachers, retirees, trade unionists, campesinos, students and women's groups adopted a unified platform of demands addressed to the national government.
